brief:
Gaza's civil defence recovered the remains of 11 Palestinians from the al-Sawafiri house in Gaza City's Zeitoun neighbourhood during a three-day operation, Al Jazeera reported. The recovery effort focused on a single residential building in the densely populated district of the territory's largest city.

Civil defence teams worked to extract remains from the structure over the multi-day period. The circumstances that led to the house's destruction and the precise timeline of the recovery operation were not detailed in initial reports.
dek: Remains of 11 Palestinians recovered from rubble in Gaza City, report says Gaza’s civil defence recovered the remains of 11 Palestinians killed in earlier Israeli air strikes on the al-Sawafiri house in Gaza City’s Zeitoun neighbourhood, Al Jazeera reported.…
title: Gaza civil defence recovers remains of 11 Palestinians from rubble
